scope: Independent source-only review of positive-recognition stage diagnostics and pre-enumeration choice evidence; no browser, tests, build, Source write or checkpoint access.

A_runtime.reason: The earlier readonly_003 result failed at a composite positive stage. This diagnostic revision has not run natively and establishes no Source/Open or workspace acceptance.

accepted_diagnostics: The formerly composite positive stage now separates navigation, Scrape click, scoped lookup, UI state and real Open-link boundaries. It records fixed start/return booleans, numeric HTTP status, exact-fixture equality, bounded counts and elapsed time; the original scoped HTTP 200, canonical identity, saved UI and Open target equality predicates remain.

safeFailureCategory maps only known pointer codes, Chromium network codes and fixed timeout/runtime categories. The catch/finally paths persist neither raw exception text nor Source URL, organization ID, Source ID, credentials, headers or response body. scrapeState contributes only booleans; the new tab diagnostic contributes count and active state.

choicesEnumeratedFromPicker is false until actual organization-picker options are read and becomes true only after that step. The current code does not treat the old readonly_003 value as proof that the account has one organization.

finding.title: An observed-choice count is still initialized before choices are observed
finding.evidence: discoverAcrossWorkspaces initializes accessibleUniqueChoices: 1 before opening or reading the picker. A fixture found in the original workspace returns with choicesEnumeratedFromPicker:false but still serializes accessibleUniqueChoices:1. The boolean prevents a careful reader from claiming a full census, yet the count's name and value independently claim an accessible unique choice was enumerated. This repeats the misleading field in readonly_003.
finding.required_repair: Initialize accessibleUniqueChoices to null/unverified and assign the actual count only after picker options are read. If the selected original must be counted before enumeration, use a separately named knownSelectedWorkspaces count. Keep choicesEnumeratedFromPicker:false until the real enumeration.
finding.resolution: The only runner code change initializes accessibleUniqueChoices to null; the existing picker-enumeration branch alone assigns a numeric count and choicesEnumeratedFromPicker=true. No recognition, Open, workspace, or cleanup acceptance predicate changed.

B_source.limits: This is a narrow diagnostic evidence correction, not a production Source defect or a change to the previously accepted read-only discovery/cleanup mechanics. Positive recognition, Open identity, multi-workspace behavior, late response, service-failure/recovery and late Save remain unverified until their own native evidence exists.

subsequent_review.scope: Independent source-only review of navigation diagnostics added after read-only native attempt 006; no browser or test execution.

A_runtime.reason: Attempt 006 predates this change and failed during positive fixture navigation. The new fields have not been observed in a native run and cannot establish the old error cause or Source recognition.

findings: The new Chromium error parser reads only a strict net::ERR_* position or the page.goto error prefix. It persists a bounded code and fixed booleans, not exception text, request URLs, Source IDs, organization IDs, headers, credentials or response bodies.

The CDP document listeners retain request IDs only in memory to correlate numeric status and fixed failure counts. The public page route records category counts while preserving the existing GET/HEAD and public-address guard; it does not permit a write or touch a Source checkpoint.

The positive acceptance path still requires the real page navigation, matching fixture URL, scoped HTTP 200 Source lookup, saved UI and Open target identity before progress. New observations do not turn a failed or missing navigation into a pass.
B_source.limit: A browser error outside the strict patterns can remain unclassified; the source change improves safe evidence but makes no claim that attempt 006's cause is already known.
